summary.text: Chris Lopez, a Republican, is a state representative for Legislative District 16, described by the Arizona Capitol Times in December 2024 as the district's newest state representative.

paragraphs.text: The Capitol Times describes him as a small-business owner of a trucking firm and a food concessions business in Casa Grande.

The Capitol Times reported that he would be vice chairman of the House Natural Resources, Energy and Water Committee and a member of the House Government Committee and the Health and Human Services Committee.
